passport.label: Still Pool
passport.description:
The pool where I can absorb my bodies. 
It records their lifetime experiences in me.

This is how I grow.

I don't like losing bodies...
But I love growing!

passport.label: Butcher
passport.description:
For when I need to turn a body into [icon=food]food and [icon=heat]heat.

Eating my own bodies makes me sad.

passport.label: Chestmaker
passport.description:
There is a family in the village famous for making sturdy chests.
They don't come cheap.

But I can bury the chest, and keep my [icon=coin]coin safe from thieves and the Purge.

passport.label: Coin Chest
passport.description: A sturdy chest. Keeps my [icon=coin]coin safe, and well hidden.

messages: The disappearances have not gone unnoticed. Agents of the Patriarchy started asking around.
A Patriarchy Inquisitor was seen in a nearby town.
There are rumors of a gathering Purge, and sightings of Patriarchy Mages.
A nearby village was razed by the Purge.
I am being hunted by the Purge. They'll kill all my bodies, one by one.

guidances.title: Suspicion
guidances.text: Suspicion tracks how close the Patriarchy is to finding you. Rising Suspicion means the Purge is getting closer.

guidances.title: Bodies At Risk
guidances.text:
First take care of [icon=food]Food - starving bodies take damage over time and will eventually die.

Insufficient [icon=heat]Heat makes bodies cold. Cold bodies output half [icon=attr_body]Body power, making it harder to get out of the spiral.

When there is not enough [icon=heat]Heat or [icon=food]Food in Cave, the [icon=attr_body]Body, [icon=attr_mind]Mind, and [icon=attr_social]Social bonuses it provides to bodies drop proportionally.

If you can't get out of the spiral, shut down everything unnecessary for immediate survival.

First make sure your bodies are not starving.

Then divert all power to Hearth until they're not cold.

guidances.title: The Purge
guidances.text:
The Purge is underway. 

It would be a good time to absorb your bodies.

They will be hunted down, one by one, until none remain. 

And then you will sleep.
For the tutorial, only Foraging is enabled.

The important notifications can be found here.

Click on a temporary one to dismiss it.

The time control are here.

You can pause/resume game and change time scale here.

The game autosaves every 5 seconds.

There are also save/load buttons in the menu.

guidances.title: Unclaimed Habiti
guidances.text:
These white orbs circling Cave are unclaimed lifetime experiences.

Tap them to internalize the Habiti.

Internalized lifetime experiences make Cave stronger, and remain between runs.

Collecting them is one of the main ways for Cave to grow.

guidances.textOverride:
This is Cave - the protagonist of this story.

Cave's attributes - [icon=attr_body]Body, [icon=attr_mind]Mind, [icon=attr_social]Social - are added to those of each of Cave's bodies. 

Cave stores [icon=heat]Heat and [icon=food]Food - the more, the bigger bodies' bonus.

This is the [icon=explore]Explore task.

When it is fully powered, it will unlock the next part of the game.

Each next [icon=explore]Explore [icon=activity]cycle costs more than the last.

I am ready to grow.
Need to absorb my bodies for that.
Select the Still Pool to continue.

Assign a body here,

Or click Select Bodies

Select the bodies you wish to absorb.

They will be destroyed, but strengthen Cave permanently in doing so.

Their Lifetime Experiences (Habiti) will become Cave's.

Your bodies are out of [icon=food]food!

Hungry bodies take damage over time, and will eventually starve to death.

You should feed them, or use them up.

Your bodies are cold!

Cold bodies output only 50% [icon=attr_body]Body power. A cold Cave's comfort is also low, further reducing the effectiveness of bodies.

To restore Cave [icon=heat]heat, you might have to assign all your bodies to [icon=heat]heat production.

The Patriarchy's magic monopoly enforcers have learned of your existence.

They will kill your bodies, one by one. 

They are unstoppable.

It would be a good idea to absorb the bodies before the Purge gets to them.

Each body consumes [icon=heat]Heat and [icon=food]Food, and contributes [icon=attr_body]Body, [icon=attr_mind]Mind, and [icon=attr_social]Social power.

Taking in too many bodies too quickly, without preparation, can send you into a cold or starvation spiral.

Luring new bodies also draws the attention of the Purge.

Be careful...

You have assigned all your bodies to a destructive task.

When the assigned bodies will finish the task, they will die.

Cave will lie dormant, until another body stumbles in, and a new run begins.

Unassign a body if that is not your intention.

You have completed the tutorial zone!

From now on, your Cave’s [icon=heat]Heat and [icon=food]Food can fall below 50%.

As these levels drop, your bodies become less efficient.

If either one reaches 0, your bodies will become cold and/or hungry.

Try to prevent that—bodies can starve to death.

Good luck!

Assign a body here

Cave likes it when there's a bit of food stashed away
Right-click on or near a body to pick it up

This is the Egg.

Assign the body here by left-clicking near the [icon=egg]egg while holding a body.

This is not the end, nor the beginning.

Cave slept, and woke up again.

Years passed, and the world continued.

The Habiti and Understandings you have gained are still with you.

This is how Cave grows - learn, absorb, then sleep, and wake up again, stronger.

Human.label: Human
Human.description:
The core lifetime experience shared by all people. 
This is what being human feels like.

Woman.label: Woman
Woman.description:
A life lived as a woman - the gender Patriarchy considers subservient. 
Expected by society to submit, to be quiet, to serve. 
To hide your strength.

Man.label: Man
Man.description:
The lifetime experience of being a man in the Patriarchy. The officially dominant gender. 
A lifetime of faking strength, of hiding vulnerability.
Of fearing you are not man enough.

Peasant.label: Peasant
Peasant.description:
A life spent working the land. 
Waking up at dawn, and working until dusk in the summer.  
Of praying that the harvest will last. 
Of winters spent huddled, hoping for spring.

Craftsman.label: Craftsman
Craftsman.description:
The lifetime of dedicating yourself to a craft. 
A life spent practicing, improving, learning the trade.
Of narrowing your world to a single thing, and doing it well.

Criminal.label: Criminal
Criminal.description: The lifetime experience of being a part of the criminal underworld.

Beggar.label: Beggar
Beggar.description: The lifetime experience of being a homeless beggar.

Monk.label: Monk
Monk.description: The experience of a lifetime spent in the cloister.

Nomad.label: Nomad
Nomad.description: A lifetime spent on the move.

Herder.label: Herder
Herder.description: A lifetime spent taking care of livestock.

Carnie.label: Carnie
Carnie.description: A lifetime spent as a carnival acrobat.

Lumberjack.label: Lumberjack
Lumberjack.description: A lifetime spent in the woods.

Cook.label: Cook
Cook.description: A lifetime spent in the kitchen.

Homosexual.label: Homosexual
Homosexual.description: The lifetime experience of being a homosexual in the Patriarchy.

Asexual.label: Asexual
Asexual.description: The lifetime experience of being asexual in the Patriarchy.

Eunuch.label: Eunuch
Eunuch.description: The lifetime experience of being a eunuch.

Noble.label: Noble
Noble.description:
The lifetime experience of being a member of the nobility in the Patriarchy.
A life of rigid rules and violent competition. Of brutal entertainment, shared in secret known to all.
Of fearing denunciation, and the Purge.

Cripple.label: Cripple
Cripple.description: The lifetime experience of being physically disabled.

Genius.label: Genius
Genius.description: The lifetime experience of having a genius-level intelligence.

Savant.label: Savant
Savant.description: The lifetime experience of being a savant.

Blind.label: Blind
Blind.description: The lifetime experience of being sightless.

Elder.label: Elder
Elder.description: The experience of having lived to an old age.

Slave.label: Slave
Slave.description:
The lifetime experience of being a slave in the Patriarchy.
A life of toil, of suffering, despair, abuse, and humiliation.
Of bearing the brand of shame on your forehead.

Artist.label: Artist
Artist.description: A lifetime dedicated to the pursuit of art and beauty.

Sociopath.label: Sociopath
Sociopath.description: A lifetime experience of living in a society without feeling empathy.

Transgender.label: Transgender
Transgender.description:
A lifetime of being treated as the wrong gender.
Keeping the truth of yourself secret from everyone else.
Playing the role you were assigned.

Beautiful.label: Beautiful
Beautiful.description: A lifetime spent with the curse and blessing of being physically beautiful.

Hideous.label: Hideous
Hideous.description: A lifetime of being physically repulsive.

Hommleter.label: Hommleter
Hommleter.description:
A lifetime lived in [icon=hommlet]Hommlet, gaining an intimate understanding of local culture, customs, and ways of doing things. 
A lifetime of sheep, cold winters, dirty secrets known by all and discussed by none. 
Of knowing that you live on the edge of wilderness, where strange and dangerous things dwell.

Peddler.label: Peddler
Peddler.description: The lifetime experience of peddling on the streets. A life of haggling over pittance, of hoping to sell enough to eat. Being forced to pay taxes, protection money. Of being robbed by the strong, and hated by the weak.

Merchant.label: Merchant
Merchant.description:
A lifetime dedicated to commerce. 
A life spent calculating risks and profits, where everything has a price.

Accountant.label: Accountant
Accountant.description: A lifetime of numbers, formulas, and ledgers. Of knowing that power comes from order and mathematics. Of seeing people as accounts and transactions.

Shaman.label: Shaman
Shaman.description: A lifetime following the old ways, of appeasing spirits and banishing ghosts. Of faith, and whispered knowledge, and fear of the strange things just outside the visible world. Of knowing that you will be burned at the stake should you be discovered.

Corrupt Official.label: Corrupt Official
Corrupt Official.description:
A lifetime of exploiting the system - taking bribes, falsifying documents, skimming off the taxes. 
A life full of greed, fear of discovery, of looking for cracks to exploit. Of knowing yourself to be corrupt, and having to justify it to yourself every day.

Heterosexual.label: Heterosexual
Heterosexual.description: A lifetime with Patriarchy's only legal sexuality.

Prostitute.label: Prostitute
Prostitute.description: A lifetime of others using you for sex.

Mother.label: Mother
Mother.description:
Having carried, birthed, and raised many children. 
The glow of pregnancy. The pain of childbirth. 
Being changed by each birth.
The anguish of burying those you gave life to.

what_am_i.label: More Than The Sum Of My Parts
what_am_i.description:
I am not my bodies. They die, and I remain.

When I absorb them, their memories become part of me. I can recall every detail of every life I have lived.

Yet without bodies, I remember nothing and feel nothing. Without them, I do not exist at all.

Nothing in those memories tells me what I am.

No one I have absorbed has ever known anything like me.

i_am_unborn.label: Unborn
i_am_unborn.description:
I was not carried here in a body. I waited here, somehow, unconscious. 
Things do not appear from nothing.
I still do not know how I came to be.
But I was not born.

do_locals_know_of_me.label: Incognito
do_locals_know_of_me.description:
I lived enough lives in Hommlet to know it inside out.
I know their stories, their secrets, their buried and forgotten knowledge.

Nothing like me was ever here before.

i_can_go_hard.label: Can Go Hard
i_can_go_hard.description:
I can push my bodies beyond human limits.
Run until my tendons snap.
Ignore any pain.

does_patriarchy_know_of_me.label: Obfuscated
does_patriarchy_know_of_me.description:
I found and absorbed all that the local Patriarchy agents know.

There are many non-human sentients in the world.

Goblins live in the mountains to the east. Giant squid rule the seas.

Vampires hide in the cities. Forest spirits dwell in the woods, strange and mute.

But no whisper of anything like me has ever reached this Trading Post.

how_big_can_i_get.label: Limitless
how_big_can_i_get.description:
I do not diminish with new bodies. 
They are all me. I feel like I can grow forever.

master_of_body.label: Body Mastery
master_of_body.description:
I learned every muscle, every bone, every pore on my skin.
My movement is perfectly aware, every gesture precise.
My hearts beat at the pace I wish.
I am in control.

master_of_mind.label: Mind Master
master_of_mind.description:
I looked inside, and gained mastery of my mind.
My thoughts are obedient, exploring my desires.
My emotions are precisely balanced.
I am in control of my mind.

master_of_social.label: Social Mastery
master_of_social.description:
I took full ownership of my bodies' social urges.
My facial expressions show only what I want them to.
My voice and words are precise tools.
I am in control.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description:
I learned to hide myself from human eyes.
To walk softly. To keep myself to the shadows.
To place myself where human eyes do not linger.
I am the shadows.

careful.label: Careful
careful.description:
I learned to be careful in my interactions.
To always cover my tracks, physical and social.
To be vigilant for signs of human attention.
I only reveal what I must.

prudent.label: Prudent
prudent.description:
I like being ready when I become conscious.
I can feel the egg, waiting for me.
It responds to my attention.
Preparing more sustenance.

sdaptable.label: Adaptable
sdaptable.description:
The world is full of variety, of change.
I must change with it, grow into it.
I absorb the old and embrace the new.
I adapt.

formless.label: Formless
formless.description:
I am the shape of my bodies.
Flowing, filling the containers of mind and flesh.
I envelop, absorb, change, become.
The world gives me form.

cache.label: Cache
cache.description:
The Egg grows from moist cracks in the cavern walls.
I can feel it there, separate but a part of me.
There are deeper crevasses to reach.
More sustenance to bubble up into the Egg.

passport.label: Day Laborer
passport.description:
I can work as a day laborer for [icon=coin]coin. 

Hauling water, harvesting barley, cleaning stables: whatever work locals will pay a stranger to do.

If I keep my wages with the employer, they'll steal the money, bit by bit.

Strangers are not well liked in [icon=hommlet]Hommlet.

passport.label: Egg
passport.description:
Under the mountain, a trove of food and comfort awaits me.
I just have to crack the shell.

passport.label: Explore
passport.description:
Explore myself, the world, and my place in it. 

Who knows what I will find?

passport.label: Foraging
passport.description:
Produces [icon=food]food.

[i]Foraging in the forest for nuts and berries.
My bodies can eat these, and that makes me happy.[/i]

passport.label: Gather Wood
passport.description:
Produces [icon=wood]wood.
Gathering sticks in the forest.
I can do all kinds of things with the wood.
Especially burn it in the hearth for warmth.

passport.label: Hearth
passport.description:
My fireplace, where dead [icon=wood]wood becomes [icon=heat]heat.

I like heat. My bodies are sluggish without it.

passport.label: Hommlet
passport.description:
The village of Hommlet. 
It's a huddle of huts at the edge of the forest. 
The locals make their living mostly from raising sheep.

passport.label: Inside
passport.description:
The inside is a cavern, vast and echoing. 
Natural rock walls, soot-stained, sleek with moisture.
It is quiet here. Peaceful.

My favorite place. Home.

passport.label: Investigate Further
passport.description:
There are more secrets to the accountant, I think.

What is he doing when he's sneaking off to the woods?

notifications.title: Shaman!
notifications.text:
I waited, and followed, and watched.

The accountant visited a hut deep in the forest.

Inside, I found a shaman. She mistook me for a spirit and followed me back to the cave.

She is the accountant's lover.
Her body may be the easiest way to bring him to me.

I am tempted to absorb her at once, to see the world as she does.

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation: I have learned all I could about the accountant. I have all his secrets.

passport.label: Investigate Accountant
passport.description:
I wonder what I can find out about this accountant.

Time to listen to rumors, dig in garbage, and spy on the man.

This feels pregnant with secrets.

notifications.title: Sleuth!
notifications.text:
I found out some interesting things about the accountant.

His finances seem... unusual.

And he sneaks out into the forest every once in a while.

Very interesting.

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation: I found out everything I could here.

passport.label: Kidnap Accountant
passport.description:
Just walk into the office with my bodies, grab the Accountant, and run. 

I'll have to fight the guards off. And after that, the Purge is sure to follow.

notifications.title: Grab And Run
notifications.text:
I grabbed the accountant and dashed out. 
The guards attacked me, killing some of my bodies. It hurts, when bodies die.

But now I have the accountant, hog-tied. We'll be in the cave soon. 

The Purge is sure to follow. I must absorb him quickly.

passport.label: Kidnap the Merchant of Hommlet
passport.description:
I can kidnap the merchant: walk into his shop, tie him up, and carry him to the cave.

It's an act of crude violence, and is sure to draw a lot of unwanted attention.

notifications.title: Live By The Sword
notifications.text:
I waited for the merchant to leave his shop, keeping my bodies in the shadows.
He must have felt something was wrong; when I rushed him, he screamed and struggled. Even though I stuffed a rug into his mouth and tied him up quickly, this was noticed.

I left a body to observe [icon=hommlet]Hommlet, as the rest of my bodies carried the merchant to the cave.

Soon, people will come looking for him. I should absorb the merchant quickly.

I don't like it when people are looking for my bodies.

passport.label: Larder
passport.description: I store my [icon=food]food here, though it rots quickly.

passport.label: Lodging
passport.description:
I can pay for lodging. My bodies will have a bed and a warm meal. 

All it costs is [icon=coin]coin.

passport.label: Lure Accountant
passport.description:
I can walk in wearing his lover’s body and ask him to come with me.

They adore each other. I am warmed by the memory of her love.

He will follow her anywhere.”

notifications.title: Lovers Reunited
notifications.text:
The accountant went pale when I walked his lover's body into his office.

Terrified of discovery, he agreed to follow me into the forest. This body had loved him dearly. I could still feel the warmth of that love, and I savored it.

Once we were gone, I dragged a slave's corpse in from the market and set the office ablaze.

With luck, the Purge Inquisitors will take it for an accident and look no deeper.

Now I can absorb them both.

Their love will become part of me forever.

passport.label: Lure Villager
passport.description:
I can lure a [icon=hommlet]Hommlet native to me. 
The locals are wary of strangers, it will not be easy. 
But they are also constantly on the verge of famine. 
I can bait a villager with promises of a secret food cache, safety from the coming hunger.

It will be interesting to have one of Hommlet’s own as part of me. What secrets do they hide here?

notifications.title: A Friend In Need
notifications.text:
Slowly, I befriended one of the locals. 
Plied them with food, kept them curious with tales of an enormous hidden cache.
Enough food for the whole village to last a year.

Finally, the villager agreed to see it. Walked with me through the forest, all the way to the cave.

They are a part of me now. I should absorb the body.

passport.label: Lure the Merchant of Hommlet
passport.description:
The Merchant is careful, and slow to trust. 

I can befriend them, get close, play the ignorant villager. Plant a story about a hidden treasure in a cave.

The merchant's greed will bring them to me.

notifications.title: The Pull Of Greed
notifications.text:
I pretended to be a friendly, weak-minded villager who had stumbled onto a treasure.
The merchant fell for it eventually. The promise of coin was impossible to resist.

Now I have the merchant. The disappearance will be noticed, but I made sure the trail would be hard to follow.

Greed is such an interesting weakness. I cannot wait to absorb the merchant and truly [b]know[/b] what it feels like.

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation:
The merchant is suspicious, and won't let me approach.
Perhaps if I knew more about Hommlet, I could find a way.

passport.label: Lure Traveler
passport.description:
Lure a traveler to me. 
They will become one of my [icon=cave_body]bodies.

I like having new bodies.

passport.label: The Merchant of Hommlet
passport.description:
The merchant who visits [icon=hommlet]Hommlet every few months.

They bring knowledge and experience rare on the edge of civilization.

passport.label: A body
passport.description:
One of my bodies. 
I like having bodies. 
I can walk, think, and do things with them.

passport.label: Outside
passport.description:
Outside the cavern are the mountains and the forest, sloping down into a wide valley. 
From the entrance, high above the treetops, I can see the smoke of distant settlements.

I want to reach down and gather them into me.

reward_cave_body.title: Body Mastery
reward_cave_body.description:
I learned every muscle, every bone, every pore on my skin.
My movement is perfectly aware, every gesture precise.
My hearts beat at the pace I wish.
I am in control.

+5 [icon=attr_body]Body

reward_cave_mind.title: Mind Mastery
reward_cave_mind.description:
I looked inside, and gained mastery of my mind.
My thoughts are obedient, exploring my desires.
My emotions are precisely balanced.
I am in control of my mind.

+5 [icon=attr_mind]Mind

reward_cave_social.title: Social Mastery
reward_cave_social.description:
I took full ownership of my bodies' social urges.
My facial expressions show only what I want them to.
My voice and words are precise tools.
I am in control.

+5 [icon=attr_social]Social

foraging_option.title: Foraging
foraging_option.description: I can go foraging for nuts and berries in the surrounding forest.

luretraveler_option.title: Lure Traveler
luretraveler_option.description:
There are travelers on the roads at the edge of Forest. 
I can lure them to the cave, and they'll become my bodies.

wood_gathering_option.title: Gather Wood
wood_gathering_option.description:
There are many fallen branches and sticks on the floor of Forest.
I can collect and use them.

hearth_option.title: Hearth
hearth_option.description:
I will build a hearth in the cave. 
My bodies will be warm, comfortable, and more efficient.

spawn_butcher.title: Butcher
spawn_butcher.description:
When my bodies grow too numerous, I can butcher and eat them.
Better to lose one than let the rest starve.

absorption_option.title: Absorb Bodies
absorption_option.description:
I can absorb my bodies, internalizing their lifetime experiences.
They will become permanently a part of me, eternal.
And I will carry on their knowledge.

opt_mneq0j10_8r2h.title: Hommlet
opt_mneq0j10_8r2h.description:
The village of Hommlet. 
It's a huddle of huts at the edge of the forest. 
The locals make their living mostly from raising sheep.

opt_mnivfht6_a0y0.title: Lodging in Hommlet
opt_mnivfht6_a0y0.description: There is a barn in Hommlet that I can rent.

opt_mnivwuwz_5lm3.title: Strongbox Shop
opt_mnivwuwz_5lm3.description: There is a place where I can buy storage for my coin.

opt_mnivzf63_3667.title: Know Thyself
opt_mnivzf63_3667.description: I can explore myself, in quiet contemplation.

opt_mnj7pfax_5ot6.title: Day Labor
opt_mnj7pfax_5ot6.description: I can earn [icon=coin]coin by hiring myself out in the village.

opt_mnjhbixo_kh8y.title: Lure a Hommlet Native
opt_mnjhbixo_kh8y.description: I will lure a Hommlet native to me.

opt_mnlsy2jp_bp5c.title: Merchant Of Hommlet
opt_mnlsy2jp_bp5c.description:
There is a merchant that visits Hommlet every once in a while.
A merchant has an interesting life, with unusual experiences.
I want them.

opt_mnmhb5uj_iv8p.title: Trading Post
opt_mnmhb5uj_iv8p.description:
There is a trading post nearby. It is the commercial hub of the wild frontier.
Seems interesting to check out.

opt_mnmi55ui_jk1j.title: Slave Market
opt_mnmi55ui_jk1j.description:
There is a slave market at the Trading Post.
Could be interesting.

opt_mnnb7avu_lbxk.title: Wood Wholesaler
opt_mnnb7avu_lbxk.description: The yard where lumber is bought and shipped West.

opt_mnnjmpvt_bcjy.title: Tax Office
opt_mnnjmpvt_bcjy.description: An office of the Patriarchal Tax Authority.

opt_mntdf6l1_73df.title: What Am I?
opt_mntdf6l1_73df.description:
I want to explore myself and understand my nature.
My bodies know nothing of anything like me.
It's up to me to know myself.

opt_mnvpcwi6_5m0k.title: Hidden
opt_mnvpcwi6_5m0k.description:
I learned to hide myself from human eyes.
To walk softly. To keep myself to the shadows.
To place myself where human eyes do not linger.
I am the shadows.

+20 max [color=gold]Suspicion[/color] - delays the Purge

opt_mnvpep93_1jnj.title: Careful
opt_mnvpep93_1jnj.description:
I learned to be careful in my interactions.
To always cover my tracks, physical and social.
To be vigilant for signs of human attention.
I only reveal what I must.

+20 max [color=gold]Suspicion[/color] - delays the Purge

opt_mnvpfbu2_jp8k.title: Prudent
opt_mnvpfbu2_jp8k.description:
I like being ready when I become conscious.
I can feel the egg, waiting for me.
It responds to my attention.
Preparing more sustenance.

+300% to all [icon=egg]Egg production

opt_mnvpg3m9_8gnr.title: Adaptable
opt_mnvpg3m9_8gnr.description:
The world is full of variety, of change.
I must change with it, grow into it.
I absorb the old and embrace the new.
I adapt.


+10% [icon=xp]XP

opt_mnvpgq9g_a1fe.title: Formless
opt_mnvpgq9g_a1fe.description:
I am the shape of my bodies.
Flowing, filling the containers of mind and flesh.
I envelop, absorb, change, become.
The world gives me form.

+10% [icon=xp]XP

opt_mnvph6sk_kgfj.title: Cache
opt_mnvph6sk_kgfj.description:
The Egg grows from moist cracks in the cavern walls.
I can feel it there, separate but a part of me.
There are deeper crevasses to reach.
More sustenance to bubble up into the Egg.

+100% to all [icon=egg]Egg production

texts:
I am on a mountain, surrounded by forests.
Far from roads and fields.
My body fled here from far away.

The forest is vast, old, and stretching far from the mountain.
Beyond it is civilization - villages, fields, roads.
I am at the edge of it, in the wilderness.

The villagers believe that spirits live in the forest.
I have not seem them yet,
But should go looking.

The villagers believe many things.
Most of them untrue.
None of them are about me.

Out there, beyond the villages, lies the kingdom.
It is ruled by the Patriarchy, who control magic.
I think I might be magic.

My bodies cannot go very far from me.
But traders come to nearby villages, from the far away cities.
Cities where the Patriarchy is strong.
And magical knowledge is gathered.

There is so much to explore.
Bodies with experiences I cannot even imagine. So much to see and internalize and build. 
And all so far from my mountain.

passport.label: Wood Wholesaler
passport.description: This is where large quantities of lumber are bought and sold. Then the [icon=wood]wood is tied together in large rafts and floated downstream, towards the city.

passport.label: Slave Market
passport.description:
This is where slaves are bought and sold. 

There are many ways to become a slave in the Patriarchy.
Born into it. Sold for debt. Sold by parents. Condemned as punishment. Taken in war. Stolen from a distant village.

The market reeks of unwashed bodies and misery.


Slaves are registered and taxed by the Patriarchy. If too many go missing, someone will come asking questions.

passport.label: Slave Uprising
passport.description:
The slaves are disorganized and terrified. I can unite them, lead them in an uprising. Guide them all to me. 

The Purge is almost sure to follow.

notifications.title: Freedom!
notifications.text:
I prepared the ground meticulously. Convincing, reassuring, planning. 

Training in secret for this moment.

We rushed the guards. They killed a few of us, and then were torn apart. We ran into the forest, arrows raining down among us. But we escaped, finally free.

The survivors made their way to the cave.

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation:
There is something here that I don't quite understand. 
Some possibility.

Perhaps it is something a slave would see.

passport.label: Tax Office
passport.description:
There is a certified Accountant stationed here. 
One raised in the big cities, certified by the Patriarchy.
Deciding who lives and who dies, by writing numbers into columns.

This should be a unique and fascinating lifetime experience.

passport.label: Trading Post
passport.description:
An official Patriarchal trading post. An outpost of commerce and civilization. This squat, walled compound on the river bend is where local taxes are handled. 
The wood wholesaler and the local slave market are also here.

Slaves and anxiety go in. Lumber and coin come out.

passport.label: Trick Accountant
passport.description:
The accountant has been stealing.

I have proof enough to send him to a Patriarchy dungeon — perhaps even into a mage’s laboratory.

Perfect blackmail.
I only need to confront him and make him come to the cave.

notifications.title: Blackmailed!
notifications.text:
I confronted the accountant. He bluffed, threatened, almost set his guards on my bodies.
But eventually he broke. I let him believe I belonged to some criminal organization, and told him he was coming with me.

While some of my bodies escorted him toward the cave, the others staged his disappearance in the office. I scattered the evidence, smashed the window, and made it look as though he had fled into the river.

With luck, the Purge Inquisitors will mark it down as an ordinary crime and look no deeper.

I am probably safe. Still, I should absorb him quickly.

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation:
I think there is something odd about the accountant's accounts.

If I knew more about finances, I could probably understand and leverage this.

passport.label: Do Locals Know Of Me?
passport.description:
Maybe the local villagers know what I am. 
Even if not directly, perhaps in the stories they tell each other.
Or in children's songs.

I like children's songs.

notifications.title: Incognito
notifications.text:
I lived enough lives in Hommlet to know it inside out.
I know their stories, their secrets, their buried and forgotten knowledge.
They have many tales of spirits, ghosts, goblins.
Monsters in the mountains.

But nothing like me was ever here before.
Nobody in Hommlet ever heard of anything like me.

I am not from here, it seems.

[i]Permanent Upgrade [color=gold]Incognito[/color][/i]  
+100% to all [icon=hommlet]Hommlet production

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation:
I don't know enough about Hommlet and its people to be sure.

I should absorb more of them, gain their unique lifetime experiences.

passport.label: Does The Patriarchy Know Of Me?
passport.description:
The Patriarchy hoard knowledge and power.

Perhaps their agents in the Trading Post know what I am.

notifications.title: Obfuscated
notifications.text:
I found and absorbed all that the local Patriarchy agents know.

There are many non-human sentients in the world.

Goblins live in the mountains to the east. Giant squid rule the seas.

Vampires hide in the cities. Forest spirits dwell in the woods, strange and mute.

But no whisper of anything like me has ever reached this Trading Post.

Am I all alone?

[i]Permanent Upgrade [color=gold]Obfuscated[/color][/i]  
+100% to all [icon=trading_post]Trading Post production

conditionalActivation.inactiveExplanation:

Am I all alone?

I need to explore Trading Post, and absorb any interesting knowledge I can find there.
A Patriarchy official would be best.

passport.label: How Big Can I Get?
passport.description:
Is there a limit to my bodies? 
Can I be a legion?

notifications.title: Limitless
notifications.text:
I do not diminish with new bodies. 

They are all me. I feel like I can grow forever.

But when I spend some time away from the cave with a body, it starts feeling strange.

Perhaps I have limitations other than size.

[i]Permanent Upgrade [color=gold]Limitless[/color][/i]  
+10% [icon=xp]XP

passport.label: How Did I Come To Be?
passport.description:
Where was I, before the first body became me?

Did the body carry me in it?

notifications.title: Unborn
notifications.text:
I was not carried here in a body. I waited here, somehow, unconscious. 
Things do not appear from nothing.
I still do not know how I came to be.
But I was not born.

In trying to crack the mystery of how I came to be, I learned a lot about human reproduction. 
I experienced motherhood, and childhood, and birth, and infancy. 
A mother's love. A baby's trust.

It is sad, that their experiences just... disappear. 
As if they never lived.


[i]Permanent Upgrade [color=gold]Unborn[/color][/i]  
+3 [icon=attr_body]Body
+3 [icon=attr_social]Social
+3 [icon=attr_mind]Mind

passport.label: How Hard Can I Go?
passport.description:
How much can I push my bodies?
What can I achieve if I push my bodies beyond human limits?

I am a bit scared.
This is going to hurt.

notifications.title: I Can Go Hard
notifications.text:
I can push my bodies beyond human limits.
Run until my tendons snap.
Ignore any pain.

I can ignore a body. 
I cannot will myself to not have it.
When a body dies, I can no longer recall its memories.
Unless I absorbed it.

+10 [icon=attr_body]Body

passport.label: What Am I?
passport.description:
Am I my bodies? 
Am I a spirit?
Am I a god?

I need to explore myself. To experiment.

To understand.

notifications.title: The more I know, the less I know
notifications.text:
I am not my bodies. They die, and I remain.

When I absorb them, their memories become part of me. I can recall every detail of every life I have lived.

Yet without bodies, I remember nothing and feel nothing. Without them, I do not exist at all.

Nothing in those memories tells me what I am.

No one I have absorbed has ever known anything like me.

[i]Permanent Upgrade [color=gold]More Than The Sum Of My Parts[/color][/i]  
+10% [icon=xp]XP
